message: ほっといて！

name: Macaron
message: 「U-Ugh, ahhh...」

name: Synn
message: 「Macaron...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Why can't I beat you, Big Brother...!」

name: Synn
message: 「Macaron, you don't have to beat me.」

name: Macaron
message: 「No! That's not good enough...」

name: Macaron
message: 「If I'm not strong, I can't protect everyone...」

name: Macaron
message: 「I want to use my own strength so the Demons can live in peace...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Doesn't this leave a bad taste in your mouth even though we won?」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I don't know! It's Sakura-kun's fault, isn't it!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「President, please do something about this...」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun. I really think we should leave Macaron-chan alone for now.」

name: Ria
message: 「The stories about the Demon Lord I heard from my big sister and the ones Macaron-chan talks about are a little different.」

name: Ria
message: 「It doesn't seem like Macaron-chan and Re-Crea are connected right now, so...」

name: Synn
message: 「You mean this isn't something for us to get involved in as Crusaders?」

name: Ria
message: 「As long as Macaron-chan and the others don't cause any trouble, yes.」

name: Ria
message: 「I know you're worried. But we also need to listen to Macaron-chan's side of things.」

name: Synn
message: 「...I understand.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Big Brother...」

name: Synn
message: 「Macaron... I'm sorry.」

name: Macaron
message: 「...It's okay. I lost my cool too...」

name: Macaron
message: 「But you know, I want to become everyone's symbol so that everyone can live in peace.」

name: Macaron
message: 「If you and the others hurt the demons, I won't forgive you. That hasn't changed.」

name: Synn
message: 「I know. Still, remember this.」

name: Synn
message: 「We also hope that everyone can live together in harmony.」

name: Macaron
message: 「...Yeah.」

name: Macaron
message: 「I hope the 'everyone' we're talking about becomes the same soon.」

name: Synn
message: 「Macaron...!」

name: Macaron
message: 「See ya, bye-bye.」

name: Ria
message: 「She's gone...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still, if the Demon World becomes peaceful and the demons multiply, wouldn't that be bad for us?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's right! We really do need to stop your little sister with the Crusaders!」

name: Misa
message: 「She seemed even stronger than before, too...」

name: Synn
message: 「...I'm sure Macaron is trying to become a proper Demon Lord so that doesn't happen.」

name: Ria
message: 「Meaning she'll become the Demon Lord and keep the demons in line?」

name: Synn
message: 「Probably something like that.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's why... I want to lend Macaron a hand.」

name: Synn
message: 「I can't just leave Macaron alone when she's working so hard for everyone.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Always the soft touch, huh.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Demons are scary, yes, but helping others is a good thing!」

name: Ria
message: 「If you've thought it through seriously and feel that way, Synn, I won't stop you anymore.」

name: Misa
message: 「Good grief, what an unreliable reply.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, you think so...?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn's finally getting fired up, so don't throw cold water on him.」

name: Misa
message: 「Now then, let's make sure you put plenty of effort into cleaning up afterward too, shall we?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hyaah! That's right! We still have the KiraFes teardown to do...」

name: Ria
message: 「Now, now. Afterward, let's all go wild and throw an after-party, okay?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh! A lively, rowdy after-party!? Let's do our best!」

name: Synn
message: 「...Everyone, sorry for causing you all so much trouble today.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If you've got time to worry about that, hurry up and get to work, Student Council President!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, leave it to me!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Aww... I messed up again...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Yeah. But I don't want to cause Big Brother any more trouble.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Big Brother is so kind that he helps me out with all sorts of things, but...」

name: Macaron
message: 「If he stays involved with us, Big Brother will definitely be the one who ends up in a bind.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Still, the way I am right now, I can't get humans and demons to get along yet...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Sigh... What should I do now...」

name: Melphas
message: 「Oh my? You seem to be in quite a pickle, young lady.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Uhyah!? W-Who's there? A pervert!?」

name: Melphas
message: 「My, my. Mistaking someone as intellectual and refined as myself for a pervert--you truly possess a unique sense of humor.」

name: Melphas
message: 「As expected of someone aspiring to become the Demon Lord, you certainly have an eye for things.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Huh? Demon Lord... wha?」

name: Melphas
message: 「All that's left is for you to carry yourself a bit more magnanimously, which would give you even greater dignity.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Who are you? How do you know about me...」

name: Melphas
message: 「Hehe... If you are troubled, allow me to lend you my strength.」

name: Melphas
message: 「I, Melphas, one of the Seven Demon Generals...」
